overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a robust and highly targeted social media presence across decentralized, academic, and professional networks, totaling 3,580 followers. His content consistently resonates with an audience interested in computational social science, disinformation, and social media analysis. Across all platforms, he achieves high engagement rates, driven by milestone announcements such as new publications, software releases, and career opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Methodological approaches, tools (like CooRnet v2.0), and research campaigns focused on detecting coordinated link sharing and disinformation.
Sharing recruitment opportunities (postdocs and PhD positions) and celebrating major research grant acquisitions.
Promoting newly published peer-reviewed papers and upcoming speaking engagements at domain-specific conferences.

recommendations: Leverage Bluesky's high virality (repost-to-like ratio) to amplify job openings and PhD opportunities, which historically perform very well there.
Utilize LinkedIn's larger, professional follower base for high-impact visual announcements, such as photos of the research team or graphics of key paper findings to boost its engagement rate further.
Maintain a more consistent posting cadence on Mastodon to nurture the niche, tech-savvy academic community that responds well to open-source tool updates like CooRnet.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky acts as the most engaging platform by rate (6.14% average), showing excellent community interaction and high shareability, particularly for new research papers and academic opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides a highly specialized and supportive audience, yielding solid engagement (4.55% average rate) particularly on technical updates and methodological discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn serves as the primary driver of absolute reach and engagement due to its large follower base (1,850). It is exceptionally effective for professional milestones like hiring and grant awards.
